programme.title: Wedding Anniversary
programme.desc: Kahani plans a getaway in Goa to celebrate her marriage anniversary with her husband. But he gets caught up in work and she is left alone on the special day. Her night, however, takes a drastic turn when a mysterious guest arrives to accompany her.

programme.title: Pyare Mohan
programme.desc: A blind man Pyare and his deaf friend Mohan fall in love with twin sisters Preeti and Priya. But their relationships spiral into chaos when the sisters get falsely implicated in a murder case and the men have to find a way to save them.

programme.title: Shagird
programme.desc: A rookie cop questions the tactics of his superior, and attempts to track the abductors of his girlfriend.

programme.title: Dhol
programme.desc: Four young loafers wish to simplify their life by wooing a loaded heiress. Unfortunately, there's only one rich girl in the neighbourhood. The boys scamper to woo her first, not knowing that their efforts would lead them right into a murder mystery.

programme.title: Barsaat
programme.desc: The actions of Sabarwal, a trickster in the guise of a high-profile businessman, lead to the death and imprisonment of innocent people. The affected victims decide to take revenge on the trickster.

programme.title: Aankhen
programme.desc: When Vijay Singh Rajput is unceremoniously stripped of his duties as a bank manager, he decides to seek revenge by robbing the bank. To make the robbery untraceable, he trains three blind men to do the job for him.
